name: maestrly
description: Open source, self-hosted work management with agent execution
author: Maestrly contributors

scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:runner-core && npm run dev --workspace @maestrly/desktop
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace @maestrly/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev --workspace @maestrly/server
scripts.dev:runner: npm run build:runner-core && npm run dev --workspace @maestrly/runner
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:runner-core && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/desktop
scripts.build:web: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/server
scripts.build:runner: npm run build:runner-core && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/runner
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/client-sdk
scripts.build:runner-core: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/runner-core
scripts.check:desktop: npm run build:runner-core && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/desktop
scripts.check:web: npm run build:sdk && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/web
scripts.check:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/server
scripts.check:runner: npm run build:runner-core && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/runner
scripts.check:sdk: npm run build:protocol && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/client-sdk
scripts.check:runner-core: npm run build:sdk && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/runner-core
scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:protocol && npm run check:sdk && npm run check:runner-core && npm run check:server && npm run check:runner && npm run check:web && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:host-phase1
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:policy && npm run test:docs && npm run test:host-phase1
scripts.test:e2e:platform: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:e2e --workspace @maestrly/web
scripts.build:host-core: npm run build:host-protocol && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/host-core
scripts.build:host: npm run build:host-core && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/host
scripts.build:bot: npm run build:host-protocol && npm run build --workspace @maestrly/bot-desktop
scripts.check:host-phase1: npm run build:host-protocol && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/host-protocol && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/host-core && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/host && npm run check --workspace @maestrly/bot-desktop && node --test tests/host-artifacts.test.mjs
scripts.test:host-phase1: npm run build:host-core && npm test --workspace @maestrly/host-protocol && npm test --workspace @maestrly/host-core && npm test --workspace @maestrly/host && npm test --workspace @maestrly/bot-desktop && node --test tests/host-artifacts.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:bot: npm run build:bot && npm run test:e2e --workspace @maestrly/bot-desktop
scripts.test:lab:host: npm run build:host && npm run test:lab --workspace @maestrly/host
